isolation.problem: The identity data root comes from paths::data_dir(). The keychain search list comes from the home directory. A fresh --user-data-dir moves the data root only, so the owner's keychain secret still resolves and custody reads Incomplete. That is the wall three earlier lanes hit.
isolation.method: This lane ran under an isolated HOME with a keychain this lane created. macOS resolves the keychain search list from HOME when no security preference file exists, so the owner's login keychain is not in the search list of the emulated process.
